lyrics.ja: 水滴の音が響く宇宙に　耳を澄ます
lyrics.romaji: Suiteki no Oto ga Hibiku Uchuu ni Mimi wo Sumasu
lyrics.en: In a universe where the sound of water drops echoes, I listen closely
lyrics.zh: 在迴盪著水滴聲的宇宙中，側耳傾聽

lyrics.ja: 天の川が流れ着く先　時空を越えて
lyrics.romaji: Amanogawa ga Nagaretsuku Saki Jikuu wo Koete
lyrics.en: To where the Milky Way drifts ashore, crossing space-time
lyrics.zh: 越過時空，前往銀河流淌抵達之處

lyrics.ja: 水の惑星がどこかで　煌めいている
lyrics.romaji: Mizu no Wakusei ga Dokoka de Kirameite Iru
lyrics.en: A water planet is sparkling somewhere
lyrics.zh: 水之星在某處閃耀著

lyrics.ja: 飛沫上げながら泳ぐ　銀河の海
lyrics.romaji: Shibuki Agenagara Oyogu Ginga no Umi
lyrics.en: Swimming while splashing, in the sea of the galaxy
lyrics.zh: 濺起水花游動，在銀河之海中

lyrics.ja: 反射する想い 100億光年　先へ繋ぐ
lyrics.romaji: Hansha Suru Omoi Hyakuoku Kounen Saki e Tsunagu
lyrics.en: Reflected feelings connect 10 billion light-years ahead
lyrics.zh: 反射的思念，連繫到100億光年之外

lyrics.ja: 君と僕はアルビレオ　惹かれ合う彗星テイル
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Boku ha Arubireo Hikareau Suisei Teiru
lyrics.en: You and I are Albireo—comet tails drawn to each other
lyrics.zh: 你和我是天津增九，互相吸引的彗星尾

lyrics.ja: 宇宙は虹のパノラマ　インフレーション
lyrics.romaji: Uchuu ha Niji no Panorama Infureeshon
lyrics.en: The universe is a rainbow panorama—inflation
lyrics.zh: 宇宙是彩虹的全景，暴脹

lyrics.ja: 惑星の軌道も飛び出しちゃって　途方もない加速度で
lyrics.romaji: Wakusei no Kidou mo Tobidashichatte Tohou mo Nai Kasokudo de
lyrics.en: Even planetary orbits leap out—with an absurd acceleration
lyrics.zh: 連行星的軌道也飛奔而出，以驚人的加速度

lyrics.ja: 光を超えちゃおう　君となら
lyrics.romaji: Hikari wo Koechaou Kimi to Nara
lyrics.en: Let's exceed the speed of light—if it's with you
lyrics.zh: 超越光速吧，只要和你一起

lyrics.ja: キセキの果てには何が待っている？
lyrics.romaji: Kiseki no Hate ni ha Nani ga Matte Iru?
lyrics.en: What awaits at the end of miracles?
lyrics.zh: 在奇蹟的盡頭等待著什麼？

lyrics.ja: 1秒未満で生まれた世界
lyrics.romaji: Ichibyou Miman de Umareta Sekai
lyrics.en: A world born in less than a second
lyrics.zh: 在不到一秒內誕生的世界

lyrics.ja: せせらぎのようで　ゆらめきのような確率でしょう？
lyrics.romaji: Seseragi no You de Yurameki no You na Kakuritsu Deshou?
lyrics.en: A probability like a murmuring stream, like a flicker, right?
lyrics.zh: 像是潺潺流水，又像是搖曳的機率對吧？

lyrics.ja: いっせーのせ！でキラッと光って　感じ合って流星クロール
lyrics.romaji: Issenose! de Kiratto Hikatte Kanjiaatte Ryuusei Kurooru
lyrics.en: On the count of one, two, three! Flash and shine, feel each other—meteor crawl
lyrics.zh: 預備起！閃耀發光，互相感受，流星爬泳

lyrics.ja: 鏡面反射しながら　ハレーション
lyrics.romaji: Kyoumen Hansha Shinagara Hareeshon
lyrics.en: While mirror-reflecting—halation
lyrics.zh: 一邊鏡面反射，一邊光暈擴散

lyrics.ja: 永遠も軽く追い抜いちゃって　止めどない期待値で
lyrics.romaji: Eien mo Karuku Oinukuichatte Tomedonai Kitaichi de
lyrics.en: Easily overtaking even eternity—with boundless expected value
lyrics.zh: 連永恆也輕鬆超越，以無止境的期待值

lyrics.ja: 弾んで踊っちゃおう　君となら
lyrics.romaji: Hajinde Odocchaou Kimi to Nara
lyrics.en: Let's bounce and dance—if it's with you
lyrics.zh: 一起蹦跳起舞吧，只要和你一起

lyrics.ja: 連なる二重星　ずっとこのままで
lyrics.romaji: Tsuranaru Nijuu Boshi Zutto Kono Mama de
lyrics.en: A binary star in a row—forever just like this
lyrics.zh: 相連的雙星，永遠就這樣

lyrics.ja: 同じ宇宙の下で　輝き続けたい
lyrics.romaji: Onaji Uchuu no Shita de Kagayaki Tsuzuketai
lyrics.en: Under the same universe, I want to keep shining
lyrics.zh: 想在同一片宇宙下持續閃耀

lyrics.ja: 僕らレラティビティ　ずっと
lyrics.romaji: Bokura Reratibiti Zutto
lyrics.en: We are relativity—forever
lyrics.zh: 我們是相對性，永遠

lyrics.ja: 君と僕はアルビレオ　惹かれ合う彗星テイル

lyrics.ja: 連なる二重星　ずっとこのままで

lyrics.en: A binary star in a row—forever just like this
lyrics.zh: 相連的雙星，永遠就這樣

lyrics.ja: 水滴の音が響く宇宙　気付いている
lyrics.romaji: Suiteki no Oto ga Hibiku Uchuu Kizuite Iru
lyrics.en: In the universe where the sound of water drops echoes, I've noticed
lyrics.zh: 在迴盪著水滴聲的宇宙中，我察覺到了

lyrics.ja: きっと　まだ知らない　世界がある
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Mada Shiranai Sekai ga Aru
lyrics.en: There's surely a world we don't know yet
lyrics.zh: 一定還有我們尚未知曉的世界
